messages.subject: Saturday 5-a-side - are you in?
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Got a couple of drop-outs for Saturday's game at Powerleague - can you make 10am? Need to confirm numbers tonight or we lose the pitch. Also still owe me a tenner from last time!

Greg
